info.name: Gets a list of announcement subscriptions.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only announcement subscriptions that match the given lifecycle state.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the entire display name given.

params.name: id
params.description: The OCID of the announcement subscription.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return in a paginated "List" call.

params.name: page
params.description: The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, whether ascending ('ASC') or descending ('DESC').

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The criteria to sort by. You can specify only one sort order. The default sort order for the creation date of resources is descending. The default sort order for display names is ascending.
